title: Why Tabular Foundation Models Excel on Relational Data They Have Never Seen
abstract: arXiv:2611.02936v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Given a relational database (RDB) storing heterogeneous tabular information, how can we predict missing (or future) values in some target column of interest? As candidate targets are numerous in enterprise settings, it is preferable to avoid learning a new model from scratch each time there is a new prediction task. Frozen foundation models (FMs) based on in-context learning (ICL) and RDB-specific pre-training provide a viable solution, but the ideal design still remains largely unresolved. Perhaps unexpectedly, preliminary evidence has recently shown that existing single-table FMs (aka TFMs), when combined with suitable parameter-free relational encoders, can be quite competitive in practice despite zero exposure to RDB pre-training or relational data of any kind. translated_title: 为什么表格基础模型能在它们从未见过的关系数据上表现出色
translated_abstract: 给定一个存储异构表格信息的关系数据库（RDB），我们如何预测某个感兴趣的目标列中缺失（或未来）的值？由于企业环境中的候选目标众多，最好避免在每次出现新预测任务时都从头训练一个新模型。基于上下文学习（ICL）和关系数据库特定预训练的冻结基础模型（FM）提供了一种可行的解决方案，但理想的设计在很大程度上仍悬而未决。也许出乎意料的是，最近的初步证据表明，现有的单表基础模型（即TFM）在与合适的无参数关系编码器结合后，尽管完全没有接触过任何关系数据库预训练或关系数据，在实践中仍然具有相当强的竞争力。在这项工作中，我们首先通过更多样化的实验从实证角度证实了这一现象。随后我们转向本文的主要贡献，即揭示多种互补的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过多样化实验证实并深入揭示了单表表格基础模型在结合无参数关系编码器后，即使从未经过任何关系数据预训练，也能在关系数据库预测任务上表现出色的内在机制。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically confirms and explains the mechanisms behind why single-table tabular foundation models, combined with parameter-free relational encoders, excel on relational database prediction tasks despite zero exposure to relational data during pre-training.
